title: Fox at the Gate — variant 1b (108 BPM time-stretch of master): scoring truth
source: Scaled from test-song/results/scoring-truth-master.json. All times × 96.006/108. Tempo set to 108.0. Key, form and vocal presence unchanged.

stretch.method: ffmpeg rubberband filter (librubberband 3.3.0); rubberband CLI was not installed
stretch.settings: tempo=108/96.006, pitch=1, formant=preserved, pitchq=quality, transients=crisp, detector=compound, phase=laminar, window=standard, channels=together

vocal_stem.method: htdemucs (demucs 4) two-stem separation of the 48 kHz WAV; vocal stem RMS per 80 ms window; on when > -40 dBFS (the stem is bimodal: below -70 or above -30 dBFS). The stem audio is NOT committed. Regions here are the master stem regions scaled by 96.006/108; the stem was not re-separated.
vocal_stem.frame_ms_note: Master stem used 80 ms windows. Regions are wall-clock-scaled; on_fraction is unchanged.

note: This is a pitch-preserving time-stretch of the master, not a new Suno take. Score Fox Ears against 108.0 BPM and G major. Section and vocal times are the master times scaled by 96.006/108.
